comments.author: BraveStarTG
comments.body_html: From my understanding the reason the pause feature is not part of SPT is because they haven’t figure out how to pause the server while in raid. This mod for example pauses the game but the timer continues to run and while nothing moves the server is still running thus can cause a crash if you leave it paused for too long as once you unpause the game progress has to catch up to the server and can cause a crash. It’s good for maybe a couple of minutes at most and it can still cause issues and even crashes sometimes.
